content.comment_body: Hello, is there a simple method for the operator to set when the process should begin? For example, can the device be configured to activate at 04:00 AM?

Have you considered using a weekly timer? For a single activation, you can combine the weekly timer with an initialization flag, such as M8. If your device is equipped with a display, you can show the start time on a message text and adjust it directly using the cursor keys.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for operator-friendly methods to set or change the start time of a process on the device. They discuss both one-time and scheduled scenarios, mentioning features like weekly timers, initialization flags, and the ability to adjust settings easily on devices with a display.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and intuitive way for operators to manually configure the process start time, ensuring flexibility for both one-off and recurring operations.
pain_keywords: lack of simple interface for time setting
